calibration.rollingRecord: Settled-close gates: 16 correct out of the last 17 evaluated sessions. The 79,905.0 add gate ARMED on the 16:00 UTC hourly close of 80,042.0 - 137.0 points through - and price has held above it for the ninety minutes since, so the signal was early rather than late. The 79,430.0 reduce gate correctly refused to fire: the lowest low since was 79,546.8, a 116.8-point miss, and the lowest settled hourly close was 79,615.4. The single failure in the window remains the 03 September midday add gate placed below an untested high.
calibration.note: This is the session that pays for five quiet ones. Morning called the structure exactly: it read the funding inversion, the completing 1H MACD cross and the settled ETF bid, refused to flip long on the spot because 79,773.7 had already failed once, closed the short hedge instead, and left the cash explicitly earmarked for a settled close above 79,905. Every clause of that turned out right. The discipline point worth recording is that the correct action at 07:05 was NOT to buy - it was to get flat and wait for the gate, and the gate then paid 386.7 points later. Six consecutive sessions now in which a settled-close gate placed roughly 0.5 hourly ATRs beyond a proven wick has resolved correctly, so the spacing is kept unchanged again. The honest caution carried into endday: open interest FELL while price rose and the account ratio climbed from 1.04 to 1.12, so this is a covering rally with retail arriving late, not confirmed accumulation.
